replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, not really. My neuroticism levels are quite low, so big subjects like physics or biology worry me more. I find math straightforward. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I've used AI tools occasionally to check my work or get alternative explanations.
